title: Brown Leather Vest & Mini Skirt
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair and blunt bangs stands in a full-length pose against a charcoal gray backdrop. She wears a cropped brown leather vest with covered buttons over a black ribbed turtleneck, with a matching brown leather mini skirt and a gold square belt buckle. Sheer black tights and tall brown pointed-toe leather boots. Her expression is calm and direct. Even studio light with soft shadow. Palette of cognac brown, charcoal, and black. Sleek and tailored, in the style of a fall fashion lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The cognac leather and gold buckle are the focal points.
- Add 'head to toe' to keep the boots in frame.
tryThis: Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the boots.
